{"code": "import numpy as np

# Compute the difference in mean biomarker change between treatment and control
mean_diff = change_by_arm['treatment'] - change_by_arm['control']

# Compute the standard error of the difference
se_control = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'control']['biomarker_change'].std() / np.sqrt((df_clean['arm'] == 'control').sum())
se_treatment = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']['biomarker_change'].std() / np.sqrt((df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment').sum())
se_diff = np.sqrt(se_control**2 + se_treatment**2)

# Compute 95% confidence interval
z = 1.96
lower_ci = mean_diff - z * se_diff
upper_ci = mean_diff + z * se_diff

# Output results
print(f'Mean biomarker change (treatment): {change_by_arm["treatment"]:.3f}')
print(f'Mean biomarker change (control): {change_by_arm["control"]:.3f}')
print(f'Difference (treatment - control): {mean_diff:.3f}')
print(f'95% CI: [{lower_ci:.3f}, {upper_ci:.3f}]')"}
